fields.name: classes_batchSize
fields.label: Batch Size
fields.description: Controls how many stress-import panels are loaded per batch before the rest are deferred. Authored as a block-name-row modifier; the JS extracts the numeric value from the class name via regex rather than treating it as a simple on/off toggle.

fields.name: classes_headingScale
fields.label: Heading Font Size
fields.description: Sets the CSS custom property driving each panel's heading font size. Like Batch Size, this is a value-carrying modifier class (e.g. heading-scale-32px), not a boolean flag.

fields.name: classes_panelOneTarget
fields.label: Panel One — Link Target
fields.description: Whether links inside the first authored panel row open in the same browser tab or a new one. Part of a flat, positionally enumerated set of per-panel fields (one through six) rather than a repeating container/child-item structure.

fields.name: classes_panelOneConfirm
fields.label: Panel One — Confirm Before Leaving
fields.description: Whether navigating away from Panel One prompts a confirmation dialog first.

fields.name: classes_panelOneIcon
fields.label: Panel One — Icon Style
fields.description: The shape treatment applied to any icon rendered inside Panel One.

fields.name: classes_panelOneSize
fields.label: Panel One — Size Variant
fields.description: Overall padding/density treatment for Panel One, independent of the other five panels.
